deep.reconstruction:
This page has no mathematics in the theoretical sense, and it has no connection to the Gaussian-integer tables on the neighbouring folios. It holds two kinds of scratch work.

(A) Astronomical or clock time reductions, written as h ' ". Three cases can be read with confidence.
- 10h46'9.7" doubled is 21h32'19.4". Adding a correction of +2.2" gives 19.4 + 2.2 = 21.6", written 21"6.
- 10h34'9.2" doubled is 21h08'18.4". Adding a correction of about +2" gives about 21", written 21".
- In a parallel pair of columns, 21.2 / 2.8 and 18.8 / 2.5, Gauss forms 18.8 + 2.5 = 21.3, written 21"3.

So several determinations reduce to the same seconds value of about 21". This looks like a check of a clock or chronometer correction from several observations, for example sums of corresponding times plus a small reduction, as in equal altitudes. That interpretation is mine and tentative.
- The 12h29'0" and 12h16'38.4" columns (with 23 5?, 22 52 29.0, 25 32, 0.4) do not double cleanly. Their purpose is unclear.
- At the top, 16 0.4 / 16 42.4 / 18 38.4 and 28 / 29 4" / 31.0 look like successive clock readings.

(B) Money accounts in Thaler.gute Groschen.Pfennig, with 1 Th = 24 gGr and 1 gGr = 12 Pf. All the reconstructed additions are correct in this mixed radix. The figures run in three columns, the second and third possibly in other units or other accounts.
- 119.2.5 + 4.17.1 = 123.19.6.
- 10 + 65 = 75.
- 494.14.2 + 185.12.8 = 680.2.10.
- 123.19.6 + 19.15.8 = 143.11.2; 75 + 640 = 715.
- 680.2.10 + 446.21.7 + 104.16 = 1231.16.5.
- Second block:
  - 265.7.3 + 106.16 + 13.1.6 = 385.0.9.
  - 5 + 22.12 + 125 = 152.12.
  - 78 + 94.16 + 277.4 + 185.3 = 634.23.
  - Adding 166.16 and 60: 152.12 + 166.16 = 319.4 and 634.23 + 60 = 694.23.
- Combination:
  - 385.0.9 + 225.2.8 = 610.3.5.
  - 319.4 + 120 = 439.4.
  - 694.23 + 656.22.5 = 1351.21.5.
- Balance against 143.11.2 / 715 / 1231.16.5 (+x):
  - 610.3.5 − 143.11.2 = +466.16.3.
  - 439.4 − 715 = −275.20.
  - 1351.21.5 − 1231.16.5 = +120.5.0.
  - Gauss writes these differences '= x'.
- Right-hand block:
  - 69.17 + 13.1.6 = 82.18.6.
  - 137.12 + 125 = 262.12.
  - 700.6 + 556.23 = 1257.5.
  - Then 262.12 + 166.16 = 429.4 and 1257.5 + 60 = 1317.5.
  - Comparison line: 4.17.1 + 19.15.8 = 24.8.9; 65 + 640 = 705; 185.12.8 + 551.13.7 = 737.2.3, where 551.13.7 = 446.21.7 + 104.16.
- Small side sums: 138 + 82 + 680 = 900; 4 × 98.17 = 392.68; 513 − 306 − 80 = 127.
- Unexplained jottings: 431625, 36525 (days in 100 Julian years), 1110, and the words 'Lassen Sie'.
errors: No arithmetic errors found in the reconstructed sums. Apparent discrepancies in the transcription (142.11.2, 1271.16.5) disappear when these are read as 143.11.2 and 1231.16.5, which the page's own sums require.
The time columns 12h29'0" / 23 5? and 12h16'38.4" / 22 52 29.0 do not double or sum consistently as read. Their purpose could not be reconstructed, so no error can be claimed.

transcription_corrections: '1271.16.5' should be 1231.16.5: it is the sum 680.2.10 + 446.21.7 + 104.16, and the difference from 1351.21.5 is the 120.5.0 written below.
The Pf/gGr/Th structure (base 12 and 24) should be noted: entries like 680.2.10 and 446.21.7 are Thaler.Groschen.Pfennig, not decimals.
'2[?] 2,2' in the right time column: the 2.2 is a correction added to 19.4 to give 21"6.
